notes: Statement changes, forced: on the target the pinned statements of map_map_equiv_right and transport_selfDual_fourB are false (both negations are proved in Lean on the target). Mathlib's Measure.map of a map that is not a.e. measurable changed from 0 to dirac Classical.ofNonempty for a nonzero measure (PORTING.md, reused-name table), and Measure.map_of_not_aemeasurable was removed. (1) map_map_equiv_right gains the hypothesis hT : AEMeasurable T μ. In the excluded case the pinned statement read 0 = 0 and had no content; on the target it reads dirac (e c) = dirac c' for the two chosen points, which fails (α = Bool with the trivial σ-algebra, T = id, e = Bool.not). (2) transport_selfDual_fourB: SelfDual μ B contains μ.IsAddHaarMeasure, hence IsAddLeftInvariant, which says map (g + ·) μ = μ for all g; V is not assumed to be a topological group, so translations need not be measurable. With the pinned map, this forces every translation to be a.e. measurable (μ ≠ 0 by IsOpenPosMeasure). With the target map, a Dirac mass at the chosen point also satisfies it when translations are not a.e. measurable, and its transport need not be invariant. So the pinned SelfDual μ B is the target SelfDual μ B ∧ ∀ g, AEMeasurable (fun v => g + v) μ (proved in Lean on the target against a model of the pinned map), and both occurrences in the first conjunct are replaced by that conjunction (for μ on V and for Measure.map h.symm μ on V'). This is the pinned statement read with the pinned map. Measure.map h.symm μ itself keeps its meaning because h.symm is continuous, hence measurable. The fourB conjunct is unchanged. (3) map_map_equiv_left: statement unchanged and still true for every g. When g is not a.e. measurable both sides are now the same Dirac mass (0 when μ = 0) instead of both 0; the proof uses map_of_not_aemeasurable_of_ne_zero and Measure.map_eq_zero_iff. The main proof is otherwise unchanged and passes the new hypothesis to map_map_equiv_right. Downstream: M074760 restates this theorem and needs the same statement change; M070026 applies it with V = Fin r → E, where the new hypothesis is (measurable_const_add g).aemeasurable. Independently reviewed by a second model, which agreed. The underlying cause is that SelfDual (M004788) silently changed meaning; if it is fixed at the definition, the extra conjuncts here become redundant.
